page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance is more robust, achieving average tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth tests also show average read and write speeds, though the overall Passmark memory score is relatively weak.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make this instance a stable option for workloads that can leverage parallel processing rather than raw single-thread speed. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, database operations, and moderate LLM inference tasks using medium-sized models, where its average multi-core performance and 15 Gbps network bandwidth can be fully utilized.
